changes.summary: Establish the ten-step mechanical design governance contract and project-1 golden baseline.

migration.forward: Adopt governance v1 and validate all future releases.
migration.rollback: Not permitted after adoption; supersede with a new approved governance version.

changes.summary: Separate pre-composition manifest semantics from post-composition physical board enforcement; preserve fail-closed production board identity.

approval.basis: CI regression repair under the user-approved ten-step governance task

migration.forward: Run semantic role validation before composition and full board identity validation when physical boards exist.
migration.rollback: Revert only through a superseding approved migration; never disable production board identity.

changes.summary: Persist and display real milestone-based CAD design progress in the flow API, queue API, upload modal and project page.

approval.basis: explicit user request to show the active design stage and completion percentage

migration.forward: Initialize queued jobs at 3 percent and advance only at completed backend milestones through 100 percent.
migration.rollback: Supersede with an approved progress contract; do not remove progress visibility.

changes.summary: Make Split-AC delivery fail closed on labeled standard IDU/ODU blocks, equipment callouts and leaders, airflow, linked routes, minimum plotted symbol size, and independent per-sheet visual previews; keep water equipment and hot-water-return sheets bound to the user's explicit system scope.

approval.basis: explicit user request after Split-AC equipment was not visibly recognizable in project-1 previews

migration.forward: Release only when semantic linkage and per-sheet visual legibility both pass.
migration.rollback: Supersede with an approved stricter contract; never return to layer-count-only acceptance.

changes.summary: Expose the mechanical release QA phase and a durable completed/current/pending progress timeline in both customer progress interfaces.

approval.basis: explicit user request to show newly added output-production steps on the site

migration.forward: Report only persisted backend milestones and aggregate synchronous engine gates into a truthful mechanical release QA phase.
migration.rollback: Supersede through an approved contract change; do not replace real milestones with simulated percentages.

changes.summary: Make architectural north the sole directional authority and remove source print frames, inner borders and legacy footer/subtitle bands from every issued plan.

approval.basis: explicit user request based on three annotated project-1 output images

migration.forward: Preserve the source architectural north symbol through the plan transform, suppress generated north arrows, and remove only positively identified source presentation furniture.
migration.rollback: Supersede only with a stricter approved contract; never restore duplicate north graphics or source sheet furniture.

changes.summary: Migrate the project-1 golden entity floor after removing all generated north arrows, legacy subtitle bands, source MEN presentation entities and the tank/pump symbol forbidden by the approved direct-city water basis; preserve every semantic sheet, equipment and visual minimum.

approval.basis: user-approved continuation of the seven-step correction, architectural-north/frame standards and locked project-1 direct_city answer

migration.forward: Set the project-1 modelspace floor to the clean v18.4 exact-file result while retaining all per-family, plan, equipment, detail and visual gates.
migration.rollback: Do not restore forbidden presentation furniture or unapproved water equipment; supersede with a stricter semantic baseline.

changes.summary: Make the active version manifest the permanent authority for the website, CAD engine, application and generated Rule Books, current documentation, release record and production launchers; block merge and deployment on any drift.

approval.basis: explicit user request that every site and engine change remain synchronized with the latest healthy release

migration.forward: Derive active runtime versions from cad_engine/version_manifest.py and validate every replicated release surface in fail-closed CI.
migration.rollback: Supersede only with a stricter approved synchronization contract; never restore independently maintained active-version literals.

changes.summary: Add allow-listed, maximum-three-attempt automatic design recovery with durable audit history and customer-visible repair state.

approval.basis: explicit user request to let the site repair and retry failed design stages when safely possible

migration.forward: Classify failures through the allow-list, restore durable input/clean transient state, retry the same revision up to three attempts, and expose/persist every recovery action.
migration.rollback: Supersede only with a stricter approved recovery policy; never enable unlimited retries or autonomous engineering guesses.

changes.summary: Unify website, persistence and CAD authority inputs for city, rainfall and mechanical-shaft approval; return late missing-input failures to exact questions without exposing raw QA or repeating architectural analysis.

approval.basis: explicit user instruction to execute all seven corrective steps

migration.forward: Normalize legacy and new explicit answers into the v18.5 basis contract, require the same fields before queueing and at authority QA, and resume missing-input work at authority_contract.
migration.rollback: Supersede only with a stricter contract; never restore free-text equality, divergent preflight requirements or raw QA exposure.
